outcome: efficacy of IIAL in arresting obstetric hemorrhage
resumption of menstrual cycle (for uterine-sparing surgeries)
cohort: Twenty-four patients experiencing intractable obstetric hemorrhage who underwent bilateral internal iliac artery ligation at a tertiary care hospital between October 2023 and December 2024 were included.
finding: Bilateral internal iliac artery ligation is an effective and safe life-saving procedure for intractable obstetric hemorrhage, leading to improved maternal prognosis, fewer blood transfusions, shorter hospital stays, and successful resumption of menstrual cycles in uterine-sparing cases.
